exposure: expedited postpartum discharge (less than 2 days after vaginal birth or less than 3 days after cesarean birth)
routine postpartum discharge (2 days after vaginal birth or 3 days after cesarean birth)
prolonged postpartum discharge (more than 2 days after vaginal birth or more than 3 days after cesarean birth)
clinical predictors (chronic comorbid conditions, mental health conditions, obstetric complications like transfusion, chorioamnionitis, or endometritis)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 17.9 million birth hospitalizations extracted from the 2016-2020 Nationwide Readmissions Database.
finding: Expedited postpartum discharge was associated with 14% lower adjusted odds of 60-day postpartum readmission compared with routine discharge, and rates of expedited postpartum discharge increased significantly in 2020.
